records.quote: The CBAM definitive regime applies from 1 January 2026.
records.notes: 官方页面HTTP 200；引文在‘Definitive regime (from 2026)’正文中经空白归一化后连续精确命中。页面页脚明确由European Commission Directorate-General for Taxation and Customs Union管理，原publisher正确。页面未显示发布日期或最后更新时间，因此这里只核实访问日的官方在线版本，不声称存在不可变页面版本。
records.source_version: European Commission DG TAXUD live page ‘CBAM definitive regime’, accessed 2026-08-27; no visible publication/update date

records.quote:
1. An importer, including any importer with the status of an authorised CBAM declarant, shall be exempted from the obligations under this Regulation, where the net mass of the imported goods in a given calendar year does not cumulatively exceed the single mass-based threshold laid down in point 1 of Annex VII (the “single mass-based threshold”). That threshold shall apply to the total net mass of goods under all CN codes aggregated per importer and per calendar year. In such a case, the importer, including an importer with the status of an authorised CBAM declarant, shall declare that exemption in the relevant customs declaration.

2. Where, within the relevant calendar year, an importer, including any importer with the status of an authorised CBAM declarant, exceeds the single mass-based threshold, the importer or the authorised CBAM declarant shall be subject to all obligations under this Regulation in respect of all emissions embedded in all goods imported in that calendar year.
records.notes: 核对Official Journal PDF第7/24页Article 1(2)插入的Article 2a(1)-(2)：引文是两个相邻完整规范段落，不是序言也不是拼接摘录；仅归一化PDF版式换行和重复空白，并在两段之间保留一个空行。与consolidated CELEX 02023R0956-20251020的Article 2a(1)-(2)逐字及标点交叉一致。
records.source_version: OJ L 2025/2083 published 2025-10-17; cross-checked with consolidated CELEX 02023R0956-20251020, version 2025-10-20 (001.001)

records.quote: 1. The single mass-based threshold referred to in Article 2a shall be set at 50 tonnes of net mass.
records.notes: 核对Official Journal PDF第24/24页Annex II插入的Annex VII point 1：引文是完整连续的一句规范文本，不是序言也未拼接；仅归一化PDF版式空白。与consolidated CELEX 02023R0956-20251020的Annex VII point 1逐字及标点交叉一致。

records.quote:
[Article 25(1) excerpt]
Without prejudice to Article 2a, the customs authorities shall not allow the importation of goods by any person other than an authorised CBAM declarant.

[Article 6(1) excerpt]
By 30 September of each year, and for the first time in 2027 for the year 2026, each authorised CBAM declarant shall use the CBAM registry referred to in Article 14 to submit a CBAM declaration for the preceding calendar year.

[Article 22(1) excerpt]
By 30 September of each year, and for the first time in 2027 for the year 2026, the authorised CBAM declarant shall surrender via the CBAM registry a number of CBAM certificates that corresponds to the embedded emissions declared in accordance with Article 6(2), point (c), and verified in accordance with Article 8, for the calendar year preceding the surrender.
records.notes: EUR-Lex合并文本版本02023R0956—EN—20.10.2025—001.001中，三个方括号标题仅作摘录定位分隔；其后的Article 25(1)、Article 6(1)和Article 22(1)正文分别经空白归一化后逐字及标点精确核对。三段明确作为独立摘录，不声称在原文中连续。

records.quote:
Any telecommunications carrier may use, disclose, or permit access to CPNI for the purpose of providing or marketing service offerings among the categories of service (i.e., local, interexchange, and CMRS) to which the customer already subscribes from the same carrier, without customer approval.

A telecommunications carrier may use, disclose, or permit access to CPNI, without customer approval, in its provision of inside wiring installation, maintenance, and repair services.

records.quote: Small quantity generator is a generator who generates the following amounts in a calendar month: (1) Greater than 100 kilograms (220 lbs) but less than 1,000 kilograms (2200 lbs) of non-acute hazardous waste; and (2) Less than or equal to 1 kilogram (2.2 lbs) of acute hazardous waste listed in § 261.31 or § 261.33(e) of this chapter; and (3) Less than or equal to 100 kilograms (220 lbs) of any residue or contaminated soil, water, or other debris resulting from the cleanup of a spill, into or on any land or water, of any acute hazardous waste listed in § 261.31 or § 261.33(e) of this chapter.
records.notes: 原URL取得HTTP 200及application/xml；完整引文在2026-07-31版40 CFR 260.10的Small quantity generator定义中经空白归一化后连续精确命中，三个数量边界和等号方向均一致。eCFR官方agencies元数据把Environmental Protection Agency映射到Title 40 Chapter I，原publisher正确。
